g.text: 2. GenD and the final ensemble: five scores, one answer

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569

g.text: The final fusion combines scores. It does not concatenate DFD and GenD feature embeddings.

g.text: Same face crops → sample up to 24 available frames

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: One GenD input batch: [M, 3, 224, 224], where M ≤ 24. Each network handles individual frames.

g.text: Stack FIVE score logits → logistic regression

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: x = [logit(p_dfd), logit(p_pe_ft), logit(p_pe_ft_sc), logit(p_pe), logit(p_pe_sc)] → [5] per face

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a
font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: z = w · x + b → scalar; p_face = sigmoid(z) → scalar between 0 and 1

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: logit(p) = ln(p / (1 − p)). Weights were fitted on validation videos; this is not a majority vote.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Track up to 2 faces → take max(p_face). If p ≥ 0.5: FAKE; otherwise: REAL.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Confidence = max(p, 1 − p). Invalid scores return an analysis error. No weights are learned from an upload.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
